title: Weekly macro — SNB on hold, ECB pencils 25bp cut
content: The Swiss National Bank held its policy rate unchanged at last week's monetary-policy assessment; consensus had been split. The ECB minutes from the late-April meeting indicate a 25bp cut is now consensus for the June meeting. CHF moved -0.6% vs EUR on the week. For multi-currency Swiss-domiciled portfolios, base-currency-CHF clients with EUR-denominated income holdings will see a small negative translation impact in May statements. We have not changed our duration call (see mc-004).
